activity_summary: Before the rehearsal found its voice, you had the justice's roll in your hand. It was headed Justice. There were eight speeches. The cues were worn through.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the head of the roll and did not invent a cue to fill the holes.

entities.name: the old Knave
entities.context: Mentioned in Eight lines on the baton

facets.activity: Looked at a part with the cues worn off
